entities.summary: Lubov Zsiltzova-Lisenko is a Ukrainian chess player who holds the title of FIDE title of Woman International Master. She won the Ukrainian Women's Chess Championship in 1978 and is a two-time Women's Chess Olympiad individual gold medal winner.
